title: Suppression of TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling by kaurenoic acid in a mice model of monosodium urate crystals-induced acute gout.
authors: Jamil, Maryam; Zafar, Sana; Bibi, Tehmina; Buttar, Parveen Akhtar; Shal, Bushra; Shah, Kifayatullah; Din, Fakhar Ud; Seo, Eun Kyoung; Khan, Salman
one_liner_zh: 该文研究kaurenoic acid在小鼠痛风模型中抑制TLR4/NF-kB信号通路，分子对接仅针对NF-kB相关蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIM: The aim of the current study was to investigate the potential therapeutic effect of kaurenoic acid (KA) against Monosodium Urate Crystals (MSU)-induced acute gout by downregulation of NF-kappaB signaling pathway, mitigating inflammation and oxidative stress. KA potentially targeted NF-kappaB pathway activation and provided comprehensive insights through multiple approaches. This was accomplished by advanced analytical techniques. This methodology highlighted the efficacy of KA in acute gout attacks offering new approach for gout management. METHODS: In-vivo model of acute gout was established in BALB/c mice. Anti-inflammatory and urate-lowering potential was determined through pain behavioral evaluation, biochemical analysis, histological and immunohistochemical assays, radiological assessments, Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) analysis, and computational analysis. RESULTS: The paw edema, joint thickness, and the frequency and duration of acute gout flare-ups were all significantly (p < 0.001) decreased by the administration of KA. A considerable reversal of inflammation and deterioration was observed in the KA-treated groups in X-ray examination. The FTIR spectroscopy indicated the changes in the molecular makeup of tissues, and modifications of biomolecules including proteins, lipids, and carbohydrates. Histopathological changes showed marked (p < 0.001) improvements in cellular structure of the paw, and inflammatory cell infiltration in the treatment groups. Trichrome staining revealed suppressed collagen deposition, inflammation, and tissue repair in the paw. In paw tissues, the KA therapy up-regulated IkappaB-alpha expression while down-regulating toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB), inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) expression. On the other hand, KA therapy greatly increased antioxidants and decreased oxidative stress indicators significantly (p < 0.001). According to Evans's blue permeability analysis, results showed that the treatment groups' vascular permeability was intensely reduced in comparison to the diseased group. Molecular docking studies indicated that KA appeared to have a high tendency to bind to protein targets. KA was associated with the drop in the cytokines such as tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta). CONCLUSION: In conclusion, this study highlighted the potential therapeutic effect of KA in alleviating MSU-induced gout by suppressing the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activity was demonstrated by behavioral studies and advanced biochemical evaluations including blood analysis and oxido-nitrosative stress markers. Histopathological analysis, including H&E staining, immunohistochemistry, and Masson Trichrome staining, revealed tissue preservation, while FTIR and X-ray revealed structural improvements. Molecular docking verified strong binding affinity to NF-kappaB-related targets, verifying its mechanistic action. These findings suggest promising applications of KA in acute gout management due to its potent NF-kappaB modulating activity.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨海松酸（kaurenoic acid, KA）通过下调NF-kappaB信号通路，减轻炎症和氧化应激，对单钠尿酸盐晶体（Monosodium Urate Crystals, MSU）诱导的急性痛风发挥潜在治疗作用。KA可能靶向NF-kappaB通路激活，并通过多种方法提供全面见解。这通过先进分析技术实现。该方法突显了KA在急性痛风发作中的疗效，为痛风管理提供了新途径。方法：在BALB/c小鼠中建立急性痛风体内模型。通过疼痛行为评估、生化分析、组织学和免疫组织化学检测、放射学评估、傅里叶变换红外光谱（Fourier Transform Infrared, FTIR）分析和计算分析，确定抗炎和降尿酸潜力。结果：KA给药显著（p < 0.001）降低了爪水肿、关节厚度以及急性痛风发作的频率和持续时间。在X射线检查中，KA治疗组观察到炎症和恶化的显著逆转。FTIR光谱显示组织分子组成的变化，以及包括蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物在内的生物分子修饰。组织病理学变化显示，治疗组爪部细胞结构和炎症细胞浸润显著（p < 0.001）改善。三色染色显示，爪部胶原沉积、炎症和组织修复受到抑制。在爪组织中，KA治疗上调IkappaB-alpha表达，同时下调toll样受体4（toll-like receptor 4, TLR4）、核因子-kappa B（nuclear factor-kappa B, NF-kappaB）、诱导型一氧化氮合酶（inducible nitric oxide synthase, iNOS）和环氧合酶-2（cyclooxygenase-2, COX-2）表达。另一方面，KA治疗显著增加抗氧化剂并显著降低氧化应激指标（p < 0.001）。根据Evans蓝渗透性分析，结果显示治疗组血管通透性较疾病组显著降低。分子对接研究表明，KA似乎具有与蛋白靶点结合的高倾向性。KA与肿瘤坏死因子-alpha（tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha）和白细胞介素-1beta（interleukin-1beta, IL-1beta）等细胞因子的下降相关。结论：总之，本研究突显了KA通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路缓解MSU诱导痛风的潜在治疗作用。抗炎和抗氧化活性通过行为研究以及包括血液分析和氧化亚硝化应激标志物在内的先进生化评估得到证实。组织病理学分析，包括H&E染色、免疫组织化学和Masson三色染色，显示组织保存，而FTIR和X射线显示结构改善。分子对接验证了与NF-kappaB相关靶点的强结合亲和力，证实了其机制作用。这些发现表明，由于KA具有强效的NF-kappaB调节活性，其在急性痛风管理中具有广阔应用前景。
